baseline_models.reading: Woe is pronounced upon people characterized by giving short measure or diminishing what is due. The opening names the responsible agents and attaches grave blame and threatened misery to their practice.

focus_anchor.role: The woe formula assigns affliction to the plural agents named by the active participle.

baseline_models.mechanism: The nominal proclamation presents the agents of diminution as the recipients of woe. The ordinary Arabic reading supplies short measure; the verse alone leaves the transaction, its direction, and the threatened consequence unspecified.
baseline_models.reader_inference: This uses the supplied focus text and ordinary Arabic syntax and word knowledge. The packet supplies no branch for ط ف ف. No additional causal assumption is needed for the denunciation; its force can be heard as a pronouncement, warning, or imprecation.
baseline_models.containment: Preserve the ordinary condemnation of shortchanging. Do not derive an amount, instrument, historical setting, particular punishment, or a lexical image of ط ف ف from an unavailable inventory. The participial label characterizes agents without independently proving how often each individual acts.

context_deltas.reading: The shortchangers operate a directional double standard: they insist on full receipt from people and cause deficiency when they dispense by measure or weight.

focus_anchor.role: The following relative clause specifies the conduct of this named class.

activation_trace.role: The measuring-food scope includes receiving as well as dispensing a measured quantity; here the agents receive.
Complete fullness includes taking one's entire measure or right, establishing their incoming standard.
The same measuring scope now applies to their outgoing dispensation.
Weighing against an equivalent extends the specified practice to weight as well as measured volume.
The scope specifically covers making a measure or weight deficient.

structural_cues.role: Antecedent of the explanatory relative clause.

structural_cues.quote_ar: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
structural_cues.role: The first conditional describes exacting full receipt from people.
The coordinated conditional reverses the transaction's direction while retaining the acting group.

context_deltas.mechanism: The relative clause and paired conditionals turn a general agent label into a contrast between what the same people take and give. Their demonstrated demand for completeness makes the deficiency on the other side morally pointed.

changed_reading.before: Short measure is condemned, with its particular operation unspecified.
changed_reading.after: The condemned operation is self-favoring reciprocity: full incoming entitlement and deficient outgoing performance.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The text supplies the directional contrast and the branches supply the relevant measurement and completeness scopes. Deliberate self-favoring conduct is strongly suggested by the repeated pattern; no particular technique of tampering is stated.
context_deltas.containment: Do not characterize taking one's full due itself as wrongful or identify a particular commodity. The contrast supports a culpable practice, without deciding the status of an isolated accidental measurement error.

context_deltas.reading: The woe places these private transactions under an approaching universal accountability: the people who exact from others will themselves stand among humanity before the Lord.

focus_anchor.role: The warning's addressees are picked up by the demonstrative identifying those to be raised.

activation_trace.role: The firm-belief scope permits hearing the question as a summons to settled recognition of the coming reckoning.
The resurrection scope explicitly includes people standing before their Lord.
Lordship and obeyed authority identify the party before whom the traders stand.

structural_cues.role: Initial warning whose horizon is now specified.
People initially appear as the counterparties from whom the agents take.
The demonstrative returns to the agents, now described as recipients of raising.
The announced day gives the wrongdoing an event of grave consequence.
The repeated people now comprise the assembly standing for a shared Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: Demonstrative continuity and the repetition of people change the agents' position: their control of a transaction sits inside a larger relation in which they too answer to authority. On the firm-belief construal of ظن, the rebuke demands recognition adequate to that fact.

changed_reading.before: Woe condemns a wrongful exchange with an unspecified horizon.
changed_reading.after: Woe anticipates the traders' own standing within humanity's divine accountability.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The text states raising, the great day, and humanity's standing. Reading ظن as firm belief selects one supplied scope; the weaker anticipation construal remains separately live in D03. The question does not establish that the traders already profess belief or consciously reason about it.
context_deltas.containment: Keep the universal standing and moral authority. No calendar proximity, duration of the day, or physical weighing apparatus is specified here.

context_deltas.reading: On the alternative supposition sense of يظن, the warning challenges even a shortchanger's failure to entertain being raised: the possibility of accountability should interrupt confident self-favoring calculation.

focus_anchor.role: The threat can address the calculating agents before settled conviction has been achieved.

activation_trace.role: The scope allows uncertain supposition, providing a lower epistemic threshold than the firm-belief reading.

structural_cues.role: The same practical warning remains addressed to the shortchangers.
The rebuking question can challenge the absence of even anticipatory thought.
The magnitude of the contemplated event supplies the practical force of the anticipation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Selecting uncertain supposition changes whom the warning can reach and what cognitive response it initially demands. A severe possible return of one's conduct can unsettle the assurance with which the transaction is rigged.

changed_reading.before: The accountability reading calls for settled recognition of resurrection.
changed_reading.after: An alternative reading rebukes failure even to consider resurrection, making the warning relevant at the level of anticipation.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The weak-supposition sense is packet-supplied. The claim that entertaining the prospect should affect calculation is my reconstruction of the question's practical force. Firm belief remains a materially live alternative; the verse does not present a numerical risk argument.
context_deltas.containment: Present this as an alternative construal of the rebuke, without downgrading the passage's own assertion of the coming day or claiming that uncertainty is its final recommended state.

context_deltas.reading: The woe acquires documentary and judicial weight: the agents' wrongdoing belongs within an inscribed account or determination concerning the wicked.

focus_anchor.role: The initially unspecified pronouncement is developed through the book concerning the wicked.

activation_trace.role: The written-book scope grounds inscription and documentary form.
The binding-decree scope preserves a live juridical force alongside a written record.
Departure from right supplies the moral category in which the opening practice is contextualized.
Marked writing and administrative recording make the inscription explicit.

structural_cues.role: The initial moral charge being developed.

structural_cues.quote_ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍۢ
structural_cues.role: The emphatic assertion shifts from the agents' expectation to a book concerning the wicked.
The question makes the named designation a matter requiring disclosure.
The concise inscription formula supplies the documentary quality.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence moves from exchange to accountability and then inscription. This gives the opening woe the character of a registered moral case or established determination, rather than leaving its force entirely in the exclamation itself.

changed_reading.before: Woe announces blame and future accountability.
changed_reading.after: Woe is supported by the passage's language of a marked book concerning the wicked.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies book, marked writing, and the category of wickedness. Their application to the opening conduct follows the discourse sequence. Whether the book is foregrounded as a record, decree, or both remains open; a commercial ledger is an additional analogy reserved for O01.
context_deltas.containment: Do not infer numbered entries, an exhaustive inventory of specific frauds, or the physical location and structure of Sijjin. The transition relates moral categories without proving that every member of each later category is a shortchanger.

context_deltas.reading: The repeated woe formula aligns shortchanging with refusal of reckoning. The opening offense is reread as part of a culpable relation to truth and responsibility, reaching beyond the mechanics of deficient delivery.

focus_anchor.role: The complete opening formula is echoed with deniers occupying the agent slot.

activation_trace.role: Declaring a report false gives the second woe its specified addressees.
The reckoning-and-recompense scope names what those addressees deny.
Overstepping a bound into injustice characterizes the denial morally.
The false-tales scope belongs to the denier's dismissive characterization of the recited signs.

structural_cues.role: First woe followed by an account of its agents' conduct.

structural_cues.quote_ar: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
structural_cues.role: The first relative definition supplies the structural pattern.
The repeated formula adds an explicit day and substitutes another culpable participial class.
A second relative definition identifies rejection of recompense.

structural_cues.quote_ar: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
structural_cues.role: The restriction associates this denial with transgressive conduct.

structural_cues.quote_ar: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
structural_cues.role: Another conditional gives the denial a recurring verbal expression.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated woe, plural agent forms, and relative definitions place economic diminution and rejection of recompense in parallel. The intervening resurrection question makes their relation specifically one of answerability.

changed_reading.before: The opening identifies a wrongful standard in transactions.
changed_reading.after: That standard is framed alongside transgression and rejection of the truth of recompense.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The formulaic parallel and the content of the denial are supplied. Describing shortchanging as conduct that acts as though accountability could be evaded is a reader's ethical inference. The passage does not state a universal logical identity between every shortchanger and every denier.
context_deltas.containment: Retain the alignment and distinguish the denier's speech from the passage's own evaluation. Do not turn this into a rule classifying every dishonest transaction as an explicit profession of unbelief.

context_deltas.reading: The woe includes an inward cost already developing through conduct: what the agents acquire can overpower the very faculty with which they recognize and assess consequences.

focus_anchor.role: The acquiring agents at the opening provide the concrete practice through which the later account of earning can be heard.

activation_trace.role: Seeking and obtaining gain for oneself reconnects the earned conduct to the opening's acquisitive transactions.
The heart's scope includes understanding and inward faculty, making the cost cognitive and moral.

structural_cues.role: The warning attaches the consequences to the acting people.
Their initial action pursues complete incoming gain.
The dismissive verdict immediately precedes the explanation concerning their hearts.

structural_cues.quote_ar: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
structural_cues.role: The corrective بل attributes the heart's overpowering condition to what they had been earning.

context_deltas.mechanism: What is acquired becomes the grammatical source of an inward effect. Returning this relation to the shortchanger makes acquisition double-sided: a gain pursued in dealings can become a loss in the capacity to acknowledge truth.

changed_reading.before: Woe threatens the shortchanger with an eventual adverse reckoning.
changed_reading.after: The warning also exposes a present process in which repeated acquired conduct impairs the agent's inward discernment.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The text supplies the connection between earned conduct and hearts, including the habitual construction كانوا يكسبون. Including shortchanging among that conduct follows the opening sequence; reducing all earning here to money would exceed it. The gain/loss formulation is my explanatory analogy.
context_deltas.containment: Speak of moral and cognitive impairment without inventing a medical mechanism or a supplied rust branch. This does not establish that every financial gain clouds the heart or that every later act has shortchanging as its sole cause.

context_deltas.reading: The woe develops into deprivation of access to the Lord, exposure to the blazing fire, and confrontation with the reality previously denied. The opening's threatened loss therefore includes relationship, suffering, and recognition.

focus_anchor.role: The general affliction formula can receive these later specifications of consequence.

activation_trace.role: The scope of preventing access grounds the deprivation expressed by being barred from their Lord.
Encountering and suffering fire's heat fits the specified consequence.
Blazing fire and intense heat determine the relevant fire image.

structural_cues.role: Opening threat awaiting contextual specification.
The repeated warning bridges the opening to the described consequences for deniers.

structural_cues.quote_ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ
structural_cues.role: Access to their Lord is denied on that day.
The next clause specifies suffering fire.

structural_cues.quote_ar: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
structural_cues.role: The demonstrative confronts the agents with what their former denial rejected.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated woe and the sequence of consequences fill out the opening threat. The final reported address makes denial rebound upon its agents as recognition of the thing denied.

changed_reading.before: Woe leaves the form of the agents' misery open.
changed_reading.after: The developed warning includes exclusion, fiery suffering, and an explicit encounter with the denied consequence.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The consequences are stated for the continuing denier group. Their illumination of the opening warning is supplied by discourse continuity and the repeated formula, rather than a new claim that all named groups are extensionally identical.
context_deltas.containment: Preserve the text's exclusion and fire. Do not specify the manner of divine access or sight, the material of a barrier, or a detailed timetable from ثم.

context_deltas.reading: The paired books give the opening's demand for fair dealing a positive counterpart: righteousness receives its own marked and witnessed standing, and truthful dealing can belong to that honored side.

focus_anchor.role: The deficient dealers are reassessed against the explicitly contrasted class of the righteous.

activation_trace.role: Expansive righteousness is the ordinary category of the positive counterpart.
Truth holding in word and deed explicitly includes a sale free of lying and betrayal, connecting righteousness back to dealing.
Marked inscription supplies the same documentary qualification used for the other book.
Presence with witnessing makes the positive record attended or witnessed.

structural_cues.role: Opening class characterized by defective dealing.

structural_cues.quote_ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍۢ
structural_cues.role: Negative member of the paired book constructions.
The earlier inscription formula.

structural_cues.quote_ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ
structural_cues.role: The closely repeated syntax supplies an opposed moral class and designation.
Exact repetition gives the righteous book the same documentary description.
The positive record gains the additional relation of witnessing.
The opposed class is expressly assigned well-being.

context_deltas.mechanism: A mirrored inscription structure counters the opening's asymmetry in taking and giving with a consistent language of moral registration. The truthful-sale scope makes honest transaction one concrete way the positive category can answer the opening offense.

changed_reading.before: The warning develops the adverse record and fate of culpable conduct.
changed_reading.after: The same presentation of a marked book also honors righteousness, allowing sound dealing to appear as a positive moral practice.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The paired constructions, repeated inscription phrase, witnessing, and well-being are supplied. Their relevance to reciprocal fairness is a structural inference. The inventory includes sound sale within بر; it does not make every occurrence of الأبرار mean honest merchants.
context_deltas.containment: The common inscription formula does not imply equal outcomes, identical ranks, or equal shares of every good. Do not supply the geography of Illiyyin or identify the witnesses beyond the supplied description.

context_deltas.reading: The opening warning redirects acquisitive striving toward a worthy object. The passage itself invites competition for the described good, so the shortchanger's desire for advantage can be assessed by its object and practice rather than treated as a rejection of all striving or enjoyment.

focus_anchor.role: The condemned form of acquisition is placed beside an explicitly invited form of rivalry.

activation_trace.role: The scope links preciousness, desire, and rivalry for something valued; the paired verb and participle both realize the competition.

structural_cues.role: Initial negative evaluation of a way of pursuing gain.
The opening agents actively seek their full receipt.
Righteousness and enjoyment are presented together.
Well-being becomes visibly recognizable in the recipients.
The enjoyed provision supplies the immediate setting of the invitation.
The fronted object and imperative explicitly direct rivalry toward the described good.

context_deltas.mechanism: A negative agent label at the beginning meets a positive directive to competing agents. The demonstrative gives desire a new object, while the righteous recipients and their pleasure supply its evaluative setting.

changed_reading.before: The rebuke identifies corrupt pursuit of a full personal share, without yet displaying a positive object for striving.
changed_reading.after: The rebuke coexists with an invitation to strive for a positively described good and honorable enjoyment.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The imperative, its object, and the depicted enjoyment are textual. Treating them as a redirection of the opening acquisitive impulse is my cross-passage inference. The demonstrative can refer to the immediately described drink or the encompassing blessed condition.
context_deltas.containment: Do not infer that envy, hoarding, or injuring competitors becomes permissible because these occur elsewhere in the branch's scope. The local imperative activates valued rivalry under its specified object.

context_deltas.reading: The concluding reversal makes the opening woe a return of conduct upon its agents. Those who could enjoy advantage and laugh at others become the objects of the answering laughter and requital.

focus_anchor.role: The initial affliction directed to wrongdoers gains an ending expressed as their own acts coming back as recompense.

activation_trace.role: Recompense returning from one's deed includes unfavorable requital, fitting the final question.

structural_cues.role: The opening directs consequence toward the agents of wrongdoing.
Early conduct sends deficiency outward to the counterparties.

structural_cues.quote_ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ
structural_cues.role: Former offenders laugh at believers.

structural_cues.quote_ar: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
structural_cues.role: The time marker and switched parties enact the reversal.
The answering scene places the believers in the honored spectators' position.

structural_cues.quote_ar: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
structural_cues.role: The final question expressly connects the outcome to the recipients' former acts.

context_deltas.mechanism: The directional pattern is reversed twice: the mocking parties exchange positions, and the final verb describes conduct returning as recompense. This gives the opening assignment of woe a retrospective logic of accountability for what one sends out.

changed_reading.before: The opening agents secure their advantage while another party receives the deficiency.
changed_reading.after: Their advantage is provisional within a passage whose ending returns the consequences of conduct to its doers.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The laughter reversal and relation between deeds and recompense are supplied. Connecting that return to the opening exchange is a structural inference. The text does not identify every believer with a particular cheated customer or every later offender with a particular trader.
context_deltas.containment: Do not infer a numerical one-for-one penalty, a worldly collapse of every dishonest business, or authorization for readers to administer the depicted reversal themselves.

surprising_valid_outliers.reading: The warning can be heard as the measurers themselves coming under appraisal and inscription: people who control the valuation of a transaction encounter an authoritative assessment of their own conduct.

focus_anchor.role: The focus names operators of deficient measurement, making a reversal of who evaluates whom pertinent.

activation_trace.role: The balance scope includes justice and accounting of deeds, bridging the transaction to moral assessment.
The separate valuation-and-pricing scope allows a branch-distant echo of appraisal at the people's standing.
This paired scope includes both administrative inscription and a merchant's mark on cloth, giving the record a possible commercial resonance.

structural_cues.role: Those responsible for deficient measures are the threatened class.
Their initial control of weighing establishes the appraisal domain.
The human agents now stand under an encompassing authority.
The sequence then presents a marked written determination.

surprising_valid_outliers.mechanism: Commercial weighing, standing before authority, and marked inscription form a sequence in which appraisal changes direction. The pricing branch of قوم and merchant-mark scope of رقم supply a possible echo of the agents' own procedures being turned toward them.

changed_reading.before: The warning announces that deficient dealers will stand for judgment and have an inscribed record.
changed_reading.after: The same sequence can carry the additional irony that the evaluators of others' shares are themselves appraised and entered into an authoritative account.

surprising_valid_outliers.reader_inference: The branch images are supplied, but their combination into commercial counter-appraisal is my analogy. The local verb يقوم ordinarily denotes standing; the pricing scope belongs to other uses within its mapped inventory and is not its asserted translation here.
surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a bodily and eschatological standing acquires a market-appraisal echo. It remains anchored by the opening agent label and explicit weighing, but must be qualified as a resonance. Do not claim that a literal market, price tag, merchant stamp, or balance of judgment is explicitly described.

surprising_valid_outliers.reading: The warning can include the danger that successful acquisition stupefies its agents: the gain they pursue may settle over discernment like drowsiness or an intoxicating drink.

focus_anchor.role: The warning turns upon the agents whose apparent advantage can become a loss of inward command.

activation_trace.role: The precise scope is the settling dominance of drowsiness or wine in the head, eye, or heart, supplying a material model of impaired awareness.
Gain sought and obtained for oneself supplies the metaphorical agent of that stupefaction.
The inward faculty of understanding is the point of contact between the literal branch scope and the ethical analogy.

structural_cues.role: The warned agents are defined through their way of acquiring.
Their active command over full receipt gives the later loss of command its irony.

structural_cues.quote_ar: رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
structural_cues.role: Earned conduct is represented as overpowering the agents' hearts.

surprising_valid_outliers.mechanism: The supplied wine-and-drowsiness image gives a concrete possible modality to D06's general inward harm: what the agents seem to control overtakes the faculty controlling their judgments. The focus's woe can therefore expose an advantage that becomes stupefaction.

changed_reading.before: Earned conduct has an adverse effect upon the heart.
changed_reading.after: An exploratory material analogy depicts that effect as the self-obscuring stupor of acquisition.

surprising_valid_outliers.reader_inference: The physiological image and its heart scope are packet-supplied. Applying it metaphorically to gain, and particularly the gains sought through shortchanging, is my causal analogy. The ordinary text-backed reading of moral overpowering needs no intoxication comparison.
surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the account of dishonest dealing is illuminated by wine or sleep. Its anchor is the actual earned-conduct-to-heart construction, not a claim that the traders drank wine, were sleepy, suffered addiction, or lost responsibility.

surprising_valid_outliers.reading: The later provision permits a quality-sensitive extension of the warning: shortchanging can be imagined as subtracting the worth of what is given, while a choice, secured drink with an explicitly valued mixture models giving whose composition enhances the recipient's good.

focus_anchor.role: The agents of deficient delivery provide the point of return for a contrast with the quality of delivered drink.

activation_trace.role: The sole scope identifies wine or its choicest pure part, foregrounding the quality of provision.
The sealing-and-impression scope supports the described drink's sealed presentation.
Mixing drink with another substance is explicitly present within this positively described provision.
The spring scope identifies the named admixture's source as a water-source used by those brought near.

structural_cues.role: Focus label for those who make another's receipt deficient.
Actual deficient dispensation anchors the transfer from quantity to the worth of provision.
Recipients are supplied a choice sealed drink.
The mixture is explicitly specified and associated with a named source.
The source is honored through its relation to the people brought near.

surprising_valid_outliers.mechanism: The opening contrasts full receipt with deficient giving; the later scene attends to the character of what recipients are given. Sealing, choice quality, and a praised mixture allow a material analogy in which diminution concerns delivered worth, while mixing can itself be beneficial.

changed_reading.before: The specified shortchanging concerns amount in measure and weight.
changed_reading.after: An exploratory extension tests the integrity of delivered quality as well as quantity, distinguishing harmful subtraction of worth from valued composition.

surprising_valid_outliers.reader_inference: The choice drink, sealing, mixture, and spring are supplied. Reading sealing as an assurance of integrity and the mixture as enhancing value is an inference from their positive setting. Actual concealment, dilution fraud, and a trader's obligation to declare ingredients are not stated.
surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a banquet drink illuminates the warning against deficient trade. The focus's deficient-giving label sustains the analogy, but downstream prose must mark its transfer from amount to quality. Do not assert that the shortchangers sold adulterated wine, that mixture contradicts purity, or that the text specifies unmixed portions and exact ratios for different ranks.

surprising_valid_outliers.reading: The focus can also carry a social shortmeasure: people claim authority to size up others while withholding fair recognition, enjoying their own position and depreciating believers as astray.

focus_anchor.role: The diminished due in the focus becomes an analogy for diminished recognition in the later social scene.

activation_trace.role: The separate scope of standing and worth that carries weight supplies a bridge from weighing quantities to valuing persons.
The reputation-consuming scope of making sport of people sharpens the possible social cost of the agents' enjoyment.
Entrusted guardianship is precisely the authority that the clause denies to these observers.

structural_cues.role: The class whose dealings diminish another's due.

structural_cues.quote_ar: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
structural_cues.role: The opening relative and conditional pattern defines a self-favoring relation to other people.

structural_cues.quote_ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ
structural_cues.role: The later offenders' enjoyment is directed at believers.
Another conditional gives the relation a recurring exchange of mocking signals.

structural_cues.quote_ar: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُوا۟ فَكِهِينَ
structural_cues.role: The agents return to their own circle in a state of enjoyment.

structural_cues.quote_ar: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
structural_cues.role: Seeing the others triggers an adverse judgment about their standing in guidance.
The passage denies them a commission to exercise this oversight.

surprising_valid_outliers.mechanism: Repeated conditional descriptions carry the pattern of habitual dealings into a social encounter. The worth branch of weighing and the reputation scope of enjoyment allow short measure to become an analogy for depreciating others under self-assumed evaluative authority.

changed_reading.before: The focus condemns an asymmetry in measured material rights.
changed_reading.after: A coexisting exploratory reading recognizes a comparable asymmetry in the allocation of social and moral recognition.

surprising_valid_outliers.reader_inference: The mocking behavior, adverse label, return to one's circle, and denied commission are textual. Social shortmeasure is my transfer of the opening pattern. The reputation scope belongs to related uses of فكه; فكهين can ordinarily describe their delighted or insolent state without specifying backbiting at home.
surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a measurement offense extends to reputation and standing. The exact conditional parallels and explicit denied oversight anchor it, but it remains an ethical analogy. Do not erase the commercial reading, assume the households endorsed the ridicule, equate all later offenders with the opening dealers, or invent a branch for غ م ز.

summary.ordinary_reading: 83:1 pronounces woe upon shortchangers. The immediate relative clauses identify their self-favoring practice: taking their own receipt in full while diminishing what they measure or weigh for others. The wider window develops that warning through resurrection, moral inscription, denied access and fire, and the return of deeds as recompense.
coexisting_readings: A transactional reading emphasizes reciprocal rights and the unequal standards applied by the same agents.

An accountability reading places the dealers within humanity's standing before its Lord. A distinct exploratory construal of يظن makes even anticipation of that event sufficient to challenge their assurance.
The repeated woe and relative definitions align deficient dealing with transgression and rejection of reckoning, without establishing an exhaustive identity of the named groups.
The acquired-conduct-to-heart construction adds an inward consequence; the intoxication or drowsiness analogy is a separately qualified material exploration of that consequence.
The paired marked books and honored righteous class supply a positive counterpart in truthful conduct, while the invitation to compete redirects striving toward the described good.

The final reversal and requital make the warning a return of conduct to its doers. Commercial appraisal, quality-sensitive provision, and fair social recognition remain exploratory extensions anchored in specific wording and relations.
